title: Careers at Weldclass
content:
We are always on lookout for great talent and enthusiastic team players!

At Weldclass, the first thing we look for is a positive attitude, a good fit with our team culture, and alignment with our values. Prior experience in our direct industry is not essential. Our team is made up of persons from many different industries, backgrounds, age groups, and cultures, and with many and varied skills and qualifications.

Read on for more info, or scroll down to complete expression of interest form .

Working at Weldclass

Some of the benefits of working at Weldclass include;

  • A Great Team Culture. As Weldclass has grown from a small business to a larger company, we have worked hard to preserve a ‘family business’ culture of caring and doing the best for our team and customers, rather than following corporate rules and red tape.
  • Energy and Accountability: If you’re looking for an easy ride, Weldclass is not for you. But if you enjoy working in an energetic team that gets things done, makes a difference, and holds itself accountable… then read on!
  • Flexibility. Obviously, everyone in our team has a life outside Weldclass. Providing the job gets done we’re willing to be as flexible as we can with working conditions, to accomodate needs you may have such as caring for family.
  • Transparency and Trust: Instead of stifling talent with micro-management, we operate on the basis of mutual respect and confidence, with an ‘open-book’ approach. For example, company financial performance is regularly shared with all staff (not just senior management).
  • A Win-Win Bonus System: A bonus scheme is offered to ALL staff, that allows EVERYONE to be rewarded as the company grows. Ongoing team training is provided, so all staff can understand; a) ‘the numbers’ around company performance, and b) how they can contribute to growth so that the whole team wins.

What we do

Weldclass is a wholesale supplier of welding machines, accessories and consumables. Weldclass products are sold by thousands of welding / tool / industrial retailers across Australia, and beyond. Read about the Weldclass story here , and browse this website to view our products.

Surefire CNC is another division of the company, manufacturing and supplying CNC cutting machines. Read more about SureFire here .

For more about Weldclass’ background and mission click here .

Our Values

Honest = Ethical, Candid, Loyal.
Reliable = Do it well, Be a finisher, Pay attention to detail.
Dynamic = Proactive, Productive, Energetic, Determined, Decisive.
Creative = Don’t just identify problems, Solve them. Be open minded.
Inspiring = Care for others. Be a Cheerful, Lively team player. Everyone is a leader.

Location

Our head office is located at 5 Hawker Road, Tamworth NSW. Some of our team work here, and some remotely from other locations across Australia and globally. Our Tamworth facilities include modern and comfortable offices, training rooms, kitchens and dining rooms, workshop, and storage warehouse. We also have warehouses located in Sydney NSW and Perth WA.

Roles Available

As we grow and develop, various positions have and will become available at Weldclass. To recieve information on roles currently available or upcoming, please complete the expression of interest form below. Even if a position that fits your skills is not available right now, we will note your interest for any future roles that become available.

As follows are some (but not all) of the roles that may become available from time to time;

  • Customer Service: Handling of customer orders, requests and queries via phone and email
  • Sales / Inside Sales: On-road business development, or in-house sales support
  • Technical Support: Assisting customers and the team with technical queries, warranty process, etc
  • Repair Technician: Warranty repair of welding machines
  • ‘Practical’ video content creation: on-camera demonstrations, reviews and how-to explainers of Weldclass products
  • Influencer content: 3rd party reviews, features and endorsements of Weldclass products

Register your interest

If you would like to express your interest in a career at Weldclass, please complete the form below. All submissions will be kept confidential and are viewed only by our directors.

title: Batch Certificate Self-Serve Portal
content:
Quickly download a batch certificate / conformance certificate for any Weldclass welding consumable product , including welding wires, electrodes, brazing and filler rods.

How To Download A Batch Certificate

  1. Check the packaging to confirm product name, size, and batch/lot number
  2. Click here to open Weldclass Batch Certificate Portal
  3. Select Product Type, Name, & Size, then enter Batch/Lot Number in the field provided
  4. Click ‘Generate Certificate’ button to generate certificate view
  5. Click ‘Print’ button:
    For a paper copy, select your preferred printer
    For pdf copy, select ‘Save as PDF’ or ‘Print to PDF’ print option & save pdf version to your computer


Open Batch Certificate Portal

Access This Page / Portal Any Time From:

  • This link in the website footer (on any page)
  • Or, the “Resources” Tab on any consumable product page (this will automatically pre-populate the portal with the data for that specific product)

The certificate generated by this portal is for reference only and applicable only to the product selected and specified. It is the responsibility of the user to ensure the correct batch/lot number is entered, Weldclass will not be liable for any certificates produced with incorrect batch/lot number. All product information is presented as typical only, without guarantee or warranty, and Weldclass expressly disclaims any liability incurred from any reliance thereon, except for liability imposed by legislation (including the Competition and Consumer Act 2010) that cannot be excluded. No data is to be construed as an official recommendation for any welding condition or technique by Weldclass. The correct product(s), settings and techniques will vary according to individual application and users should conduct their own due diligence to determine the correct product and method to use in their situation. E.&O.E.

title: Warranty Information
content:
Warranty Registration

Register your Weldclass product warranty here… and enter our monthly draw to WIN a FREE welding helmet or jacket!

Registration within 30 days of purchase is required to qualify for extended warranty, where this is available and offered (for example, 7 year warranty as offered on various machines, welding helmets and other products). Otherwise registration is optional.

Open Warranty Registration Form

Products, Warranty Periods, Terms & Conditions

See warranty terms and conditions for full details on products covered, warranty periods, etc.

Registration is optional and failure to register will not affect your rights under the Australian Consumer Law and will not affect normal warranty cover. However, registration within 30 days of purchase is required to qualify for extended warranty, where this is offered or advertised by Weldclass. Refer to warranty terms and conditions for full details.

Monthly prize draw competition information: Promoter is JWL Marketing Pty Ltd trading as Weldclass Welding Products, 5 Hawker Rd, Tamworth NSW 2340. Monthly draws are held in the first week of each month for all entrants received in the previous month. Competition entries include warranty registration, product review submissions, and any participants in other promotional programs from time to time. Monthly winners are notified by email. Each prize is valued at or above $90.00 RRP. Prize may be substituted with an alternative item if stock is not available.

Any product feedback comments submitted on this form may be used for marketing purposes, including being added to our online product reviews & comments. We will NOT publish or share personal contact information, with the exception of first name and state which may be shown to demonstrate authenticity. Our full privacy policy can be viewed here . E. & O.E.

title: The Weldclass Story
content:
Weldclass is a national welding equipment brand. Weldclass products are developed for Australian welders and metal fabricators and are distributed through our network of over 1,000 dealers across Australia and the South Pacific region.

Australian Since 1979

We’re an Australian founded company, owned and operated in Australia since 1979.

Weldclass was founded in the regional Australian city of Tamworth, NSW and our head office is still located there today, with warehouses in Sydney and Perth, and support staff in many locations across Australia.

A little bit of history

In the early 1900’s, the forebears of the founder of Weldclass pioneered mechanical engineering in Australia, then later invented metal coating technologies that are still being used globally.

Examples of this work that remain today include; Historic Buildings at Sydney’s Olympic Park (remnants of what was the first mechanised abattoirs in Australia), and pipeline infrastructure powering Sydney’s water supply via the Warragamba Dam project.

Our Mission

Empower welders to solve real challenges through innovation – driving a safer & more rewarding future.

Our Values

Honest = Ethical, Candid, Loyal.
Reliable = Do it well, Be a finisher, Pay attention to detail.
Dynamic = Proactive, Productive, Energetic, Determined, Decisive.
Creative = Don’t just identify problems, Solve them. Do more with less. Be open minded.
Inspiring = Care for others. Be a Cheerful, Lively team player. Everyone is a leader.

Why Weldclass?

Weldclass ensures the success of their customers through 4 key pillars;

1. Easy to Deal With
A customer-friendly approach, clear communication and a helpful team.

2. Support
From easy-to-understand product information, packaging, and displays to helpful tools, resources, and after-sales support – Weldclass empowers distributors and end-users to move with speed and confidence.

3. Leading Products
That are exciting, reliable and perform at the top of their class. Weldclass is not ‘just another welding supplier’ and we don’t just ‘bring in stuff’. Behind every product range lies years of development, research, testing and perfecting.

4. Stock availability
The best products in the world are not worth much if you can’t get supply when you need it. We’ve set ourselves to provide the welding industry’s best supply rate (typically above 95%) and you can check up on our progress at the Supply-O-Meter

Our Distributors

Weldclass products are sold through our network of over 1,000 distributors across Australia and the South Pacific region.

We want the Weldclass experience to be readily available to welders and metal fabricators everywhere, and our distributors are a vital and valued ‘link in the chain’.

To fulfill our mission to make life easier for welders and retailers, Weldclass supports our distributors with training, market-leading merchandising systems, and strong after sales support.

Giving Back

We’re passionate about helping others and supporting the wider community. Weldclass enthusiastically backs causes such as Drought relief, Wheelchair sports, Cancer relief and research, Aussie service veterans, the Royal Flying Doctor Service and more. Read more about our charity support here .

Thank you

We hope you have an outstanding day!

From the Weldclass team.
